reuse.why: Extends the existing month-fill module (getMonthFillCategories, the hidden predicate) instead of adding new filtering elsewhere, and keeps isMonthFillCategory/toAverageFillAmount in use.

duplication.why: The hidden-or-templated rule is a single predicate isLockedForMonthFill used both by getMonthFillCategories and by copyPreviousMonth; the old SQL hidden filter and isHiddenForMonthCopy are removed rather than kept alongside.

placement.why: The rule lives in month-fill.ts, the module the tree dedicates to which categories month-wide actions write; actions.ts only selects the extra column.

scope.why: Touches only the month-wide actions, their category selection, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Clean single rule with a test; minor nits: the predicate's comment only mentions templates and the rule is applied in JS after fetching all categories while copyPreviousMonth reaches it through a separately typed query.

one_place.where: isLockedForMonthFill in budget/month-fill.ts, applied by getMonthFillCategories (setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) and directly in copyPreviousMonth
